friends.helpOverview: This is the quick snapshot of the section: you can immediately see how many confirmed friends you have, how many new requests need a response, and how many requests you already sent yourself.
friends.helpAdd: This is where a new connection starts. Type a username or name, pick a person from suggestions, and immediately do what makes sense: send a request, accept one, or open chat if you are already connected.
friends.helpIncoming: This block collects new incoming requests. Accept a request if you want to open the connection, or decline it if you do not need this contact.
friends.helpSent: This block stores outgoing requests. Until the other person answers, you can still cancel the request and avoid leaving it hanging.
friends.helpList: This is your live friends list. Click a person to open their card, change communication settings, add a note, or place them into the right list.
friends.helpLists: Lists help you stay organized. The same person can live in multiple lists, and later you can quickly filter friends by role, team, or context.
friends.helpPersonCard: The friend card is your quick control center: open chat, add favorites, manage privacy, and keep personal context in one place.
friends.helpControls: Communication settings only change your experience. Mute stops notifications from this person, activity sharing controls what they can see, and block fully restricts the contact from your side.
friends.helpNote: This personal note is visible only to you. It is useful for context like how you met, what the person is helpful with, what you agreed on, or how you want to communicate.
